runs.label: Atlantic cable, 1866
runs.sources: Noon positions telegraphed from the ship: Lloyd's List 20-27 July 1866; the Sun and the Express (London) 16-27 July 1866. Checked against the U.S. Hydrographic Office Chart of the North Atlantic (1869-71). Cable paid out: Herald 30 July 1866. Approach round Baccalieu and up Trinity Bay: sea waypoints, arrival 8 a.m. 27 July (Herald).

runs.label: Recovery of the 1865 cable
runs.sources: approximate: grappling positions from the Sun and the Express, 3 September 1866; the 1865 line drawn as great circles through the point where the end was raised

runs.label: Atlantic cable, 1865, completed
runs.sources: dated positions 2-7 September from the U.S. Hydrographic Office chart (1869-71); noon 4 September from the Express, 5 September 1866; times of day approximate
